files.summary: Defines differential/common-mode coordinates; derives current steering, gain, headroom, CMRR normalization and separate output common-mode feedback.
Derives an illustrative PTAT/CTAT sum, temperature/trim limits, box tempco, startup equilibria and reference/digital readiness interfaces.
Step-by-step actual SKY130 mirror and amplifier experiments, followed by six explicitly behavioral startup/ramp/brownout cases.

lab.supported_geometry_note: Model bins inspected: NMOS W5um L1um or0.15um; HVT PMOS W7um L1um. Wrapper scale1u means numeric dimension arguments in micrometres without u suffix. Diffusion extension0.29um and junction geometry are illustrative assumptions, not extracted layout.

measured_metrics.geometry_scope: W/L are supported model-bin values in micrometres. Source/drain rectangles assume0.29um extension; no layout extraction.
measured_metrics.startup_scope: Separate phenomenological ODE; no SKY130 transistor or bandgap performance is inferred.

verified_derivations: Differential-output gain -gm*RD versus single-output gain -gm*RD/2 for a pure differential input, with explicit output polarity.
Finite tail resistance changes output mean but does not by itself create differential common-mode error in exact symmetry.
Illustrative square-law current steering uses beta*vd*sqrt(Itail/beta-vd^2/4), only within both-on/headroom assumptions.
Bandgap example uses kT/q*ln8=53.758mV at300K, K about10.045 for assumed -1.8mV/K VBE slope, and output1.190V.
Offset, slope and curvature trim distinguished; box tempco includes interior extrema. Example2mV/(1.2V*165K)=10.10ppm/K.
Actual amplifier low-frequency gain from measured gm/(gdsN+gdsP) agrees with small-signal AC; AC1 is normalization rather than a1V large signal.
Mirror +/-5% intervals are accuracy windows on a5mV grid, not BSIM saturation voltages.
Behavioral startup state dynamics explicitly separate stable off/on states and test brownout recovery, with no physical bandgap inference.
technical_review.visual_review: All15 new vector diagrams/charts rendered with librsvg for targeted inspection. Added explicit shared-gate junction dots, distinguished the CMFB route crossing, corrected the phase-portrait axis range and extended the measured mirror-current chart so its short-channel endpoint is visible. Root performs final integrated HTML/browser QA.
technical_review.calculation_scope: Lesson43/44 numerical design examples are analytic and illustrative. Lab2 MOS data are actual nominal compact-model simulations. Startup data are actual simulations of an explicitly constructed behavioral model.
limitations: No fabricated-silicon validation, post-layout extraction, physical current-reference circuit or transistor-level bandgap simulation.
Captured MOS results are TT/25C/1.8V only; FF/SS/85C commands are proposed extensions and explicitly not labeled as executed.
No validated mismatch Monte Carlo, yield, noise or reliability characterization.
Calibrated amplifier bias is an external testbench operation; no claim of autonomous bias or PVT robustness.
Startup time constants and currents are chosen behavioral coefficients; first99percent crossings do not establish a physical ready contract.
Integration now links the release44manual that matches the recorded ngspice44.2 runs.
